files.html:
0.2.1 Change Log

  • Adjusted some UI texture UV mapping.
  • Fixed a GeckoLib animation playback bug
  • Removed unnecessary calculations when checking GeckoLib models.
  • Improved the way JSON files are loaded to prevent server crashes caused by large file sizes.
  • Added a default keybind setting with an on/off toggle.
